% Canonical SCI-MAP v0.1 predictions; CI-001 dimensional amendment incorporated 2026-08-16.
\newcommand{\SCIMapPredictions}{%
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-001}{Uniform constant}{For fixed membership, a constant admitted input with uniform positive coefficients produces that constant on every support-authorized raw-valid output row; numerator and normalization scale together, and no unsupported scientific row is created.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-002}{Unequally weighted constant}{For fixed membership, unequal positive coefficients still preserve the same constant on every support-authorized output row, while normalization and conditional variance generally change with position; rows outside that set have no normalized scientific value.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-003}{One-pixel hand calculation}{For an authorized row with admitted \(z_i\) and \(a_i>0\), the exact triplet is \((N,Q,\widehat m)=(\sum a_i z_i,\sum a_i,\sum a_i z_i/\sum a_i)\); an unauthorized row has no normalized scientific value.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-004}{One-hot boundary}{A finite coordinate inside exactly one half-open cell has one \(G_{pi}=1\), preserves unity over pixels, and contributes only there. A coordinate on an internal upper edge belongs to the adjacent cell; a coordinate on the outer upper extent or outside the grid contributes nowhere. Fractional splitting is not authorized.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-005}{Delta input}{A basis-pixel sky input produces the corresponding support-row-restricted column of \(R_{\rm out}=A_{\rm out}H\), including projection and boundary truncation; it need not be a delta in the output map, and no value is predicted outside the authorized rows.}{Representation fidelity}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-006}{Point-source template}{A declared point-source template \(\boldsymbol\tau_b\) produces \(R_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\tau_b\) on exactly the support-authorized rows; peak, integrated, and fitted amplitudes are distinct functionals and need separate criteria.}{Representation fidelity}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-007}{Resolved and Fourier inputs}{Resolved disks, gradients, and Fourier modes produce their explicit \(R_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\tau\) on the authorized row set; a constant-input pass does not predict preservation of these modes.}{Representation fidelity}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-008}{Variable coverage}{Fixed-coefficient constant preservation can coexist with spatially varying normalization, support-row membership, covariance, and nonconstant-template response; a row that fails support is absent rather than measured zero.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-009}{Finite boundary}{At an admitted finite edge, no contribution wraps or clamps; local normalization may preserve a constant while compact-source peak or integrated response changes.}{Representation fidelity}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-010}{Coefficient states}{Until an exact PTC-owner-selected MAP-facing coefficient family is bound, the ordinary numerical route is unavailable. Under a future exact family, zero is noncontributing, negative/non-finite is invalid, and every state retains its cause; none is inferred as unity or precision.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-011}{Use-qualified exclusion and non-finite states}{A candidate ineligible under the exact MAP admission or contribution policy for its preserved cause, or failing any required factored gate, does not contaminate an accumulator because exclusion occurs before payload evaluation. No universal flagged-candidate action is inferred.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-012}{Threshold selector}{For each predeclared positive finite coefficient population, the selected zero-based index is exactly \(\lfloor(\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N)/2\rfloor\); empty input yields threshold zero, but no pixel gains support without its own finite positive coefficient. The dimensionless identity of \(c\) is fixed; any exact numerical \(c\) value not explicitly admitted by the owner-authorized effective policy fails closed before a support row set is constructed, and no numeric domain is inferred.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-013}{Missing response}{A missing response parent yields a typed unavailable response state, never a fabricated zero or identity response. The original MAP bundle remains usable for claims that do not require response; any later simulated response or corrected map has a new versioned identity bound to that bundle.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-014}{Atomic rejection}{A missing required companion or any incompatible identity, unit, response, WCS, shape, policy, or parent rejects the entire observation before every coadd accumulator and count, including apparently compatible pixels, is changed.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-015}{One-observation coadd}{A coadd containing one admitted observation under the uniform dimensionless coefficient family reproduces its signal on corresponding centered-integer authorized rows. It reproduces response only when the exact response companion is available; otherwise response remains typed unavailable.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-016}{Uniform observation coefficients}{On each authorized coadd row, two compatible observations produce their equal-observation arithmetic mean and count-like normalization under \nolinkurl{SCI-MAP:uniform_observation_coadd_coefficient@1}. The normalization is not precision.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-017}{Missing or invalid observation}{An unsupported observation row contributes at no coadd row; an incompletely admitted observation contributes nowhere and does not increment admitted-observation count. Neither case creates a zero-valued scientific substitute.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-018}{Centered integer placement}{Compatible shape differences that are nonnegative and even produce the exact half-difference row/column offset; odd, negative, fractional, or WCS-inconsistent relations fail with no mutation.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-019}{Cross-observation covariance}{For two maps with variances \(\sigma_1^2,\sigma_2^2\) and covariance \(c\), the propagated uniform-coadd covariance includes \(c\). A missing cross block remains unknown, never zero or independence, and the equal-observation normalization is not precision.}{Algebraic contract}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-020}{Fixed noise operator}{A deterministic admitted realization propagated with fixed state yields the same support-row identities and coefficient-by-coefficient \(A_{\rm out}\) and \(B_{\rm out}\) as the signal path; recomputed state exposes a named difference.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-021}{Sequential and parallel reduction}{Integer facts, identities, masks, support, and cardinality agree exactly. Floating sums agree with a preregistered operation-count/conditioning bound that is frozen before results are viewed and is not loosened after failure.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-022}{No false significance}{A deliberate attempt to label signal times square root of merely formal weight as empirical significance is rejected or remains unmistakably labeled formal standardized signal.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-023}{No validity promotion}{A downstream product may have its own use-local validity or eligibility but cannot change MAP-local base-product validity or sever the base/unfiltered MAP parent.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-024}{No ordinary predicate for JINC}{A deliberate attempt to apply positive-coefficient ordinary admission, support, or complete-bundle availability to JINC is rejected as outside SCI-MAP v0.1.}{Engineering conformance}\par
\SCIMapPrediction{SCI-MAP-PRED-025}{Aggregate and index failure}{An exact-zero, non-finite, overflowed, or unrepresentable aggregate/index never becomes a live valid product; failure occurs at the declared scope before mutation or completion.}{Engineering conformance}\par
